newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: ENDEMOL SHARES JUMP ON SPORT 7 SALE.
newsitem.headline: ENDEMOL SHARES JUMP ON SPORT 7 SALE.

text.p: Shares in television production and entertainment group Endemol jumped 3.30 guilders to 59.80 on Tuesday after the company announced it was transferring its stake in loss-making TV channel Sport 7 to its management.

"The risks for Endemol have been eliminated, and that has been very positively interpreted by investors," said one dealer, adding "short term it is a good move, but it means that if Sport 7 comes good, Endemol's revenues will be limited to programme-making."
The company said Endemol founders Joop Van Ende and John de Mol would acquire the stake at the initial price paid.
